notes.title: New update, new project, Fall Sale and other thrilling news!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32132260/affa0ffda09c40e9a187bd97573b6093d5baa83e.jpg

We have been hard at work on an exciting new project, The Endless Wyrd. In this dice-based, deck-building roguelike adventure, scavenge the Wyrd and escape the tentacles and teeth of The Thing of the Dark. Load your dice with powerful augments to create your own synergies and combos and stack the odds in your favour. In the rabbit hole of the Wyrd, the only way back up, is down. 

Don’t miss out on exciting updates and announcements and follow The Endless Wyrd on twitter. We will be launching an in-game trailer soon! 

Because of our hectic production timelines to launch The Endless Wyrd on early access on Steam, we will be halting monthly story packs for Fhtagn! However, you can still create your own fun stories for you and friends to play in-game (read more about it here). Fhtagn!’s Discord server is also a great space to test ideas, get feedback and receive assistance and guidance from us. It’s a fun community full of cultish shenanigans, where you can chat to friendly folks and have a prohibition cocktail at Madame Fufu’s to boot. 

New feature update in Fhtagn! - V2.1.2.a
We will continue to support and maintain Fhtagn! and have recently added a new feature to the game that enables players to delete saved files. This is useful if your Steam files somehow got corrupted or if you want a fresh start to the game. Please note that using this feature will remove all elders signs and unlocks. The feature is located in the Settings menu. 

[previewyoutube=yCgnlvfor8k;full][/previewyoutube]
Special Promotion: Fall Sale
To celebrate the creepiest season of the year, we are having a Fall Sale. Please note that Fhtagn! is currently our means to fund the amazing new projects we’re developing, like The Creeping Madness and The Endless Wyrd. The more copies of Fhtagn! that are purchased, the more resources we have to effectively develop new projects and reduce production timelines. As bootstrapping Indies we could really use your support! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32132260/b0355402e85a67c41e8925083872cd882adcf83b.gif

Connect with us
There is only one thing we like more than making games and that is to connect with the community. We have various social platforms available for you to enhance your experience of Fhtagn!, from our website, twitter, subreddit, newsletter and our Discord server.

What the Fhtagn! are you waiting for? Drop us a comment or feel free to connect with us on the social platforms mentioned above.

notes.title: Announcing the end of the world with the release of Fhtagn! on 22 May 2018!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our story-adventure mini-game, Fhtagn, is releasing on Steam tomorrow, 22 May 2018! The time is finally at hand to perform the great ritual and everything has been meticulously prepared. The sacred spoon of Scoo’p has been polished to an evil gleam, the Shoggoth was given a juicy bone and the altar was sprinkled with ketchup (the Ancient One’s favourite). All we need now is for you to fulfil your ritual role and to end the world for good… or evil in this case!
 
To help you prepare for your fiendish role, we’ve created a gameplay video that will provide you with a sneak peek of what to expect. You will need all the help you can get when you battle investigators, corrupt cops and Ancient horrors, as you traverse the unsuspecting town of Arkham.

The story-adventures don’t end when you’ve completed the game, you can download playable mods from the Steam Workshop or you can create your own Lovecraftian events (or any story you want) with our content creator.

We’re looking forward to ending the world and descending into madness with you! ːsteamhappyː
